name: Scan Projects Ltd.
summary: Scan Projects Ltd. specializes in the full lifecycle of industrial machinery and specialized equipment, encompassing their manufacturing, initial setup, deployment, and ongoing annual servicing. In addition to these core services, the company also engages in the wholesale distribution of industrial apparatus, materials for fabrication, components, and various other related items. Established on February 20, 1992, the firm's primary operations are based in Yamuna Nagar, India.
